policy.viaWay: conservative member-way closure in this first cost prototype
policy.uTurns: Exact reverse physical arc only; permitted at source-way ends, selected-profile junctions, tagged or explicit relation nodes. Validation-window cuts never grant reversal permission.
policy.scope: Assumed static travel costs and limited OSM car rules; no traffic, current availability, vehicle dimensions or nationwide ETA/coverage certification.
policy.invalidUnlocatableRestrictions: Retain full source record and count as invalid-unlocatable; no inferred road closure or nested-relation expansion. Every record with a direct node/way member retains V1 handling.

scope: Fixed 100m geometry/10000ms time-progress error at discarded source vertices; source costs and core graph unchanged. No snap, ETA, app or model admission.
